features.name: Hold & Spin
features.description: Six badges start three respins that reset.

features.name: Five-tier jackpot
features.description: Mini, Minor, Major, Mega and Grand.

review:
Badge Blitz is a 5x3 western slot with two bonus games and a five-tier jackpot. Horse wilds help form wins, and six or more sheriff badges trigger Hold & Spin.

In the bonus, badges become money symbols and you get three respins. New badges or Mini, Minor, Major and Mega jackpot symbols reset the count, and filling every position awards the Grand jackpot. A separate free spins bonus is also available. Pragmatic Play advertises up to 5,000x. The RTP is 96.5%.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
